PagerDuty: INCIDENT ⛑️ — page fired for service=edge-proxy cluster=lb-eu-1 reason=TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE spike (pd:PD-87432) <https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-87432|open incident>
SRE Bot: Auto-created incident channel: #incident-PD-87432 (ops runbook: /runbooks/edge-tls)
Alex (oncall): acked. I'm switching to incident channel, joining bridge.
Maria (sre): seeing 5xx/TLS errors in prod metrics, started gathering traces. ETA 5m for first triage. :eyes:
Tariq (net-eng): noticed identical ciphers failing on ~25% of connections to eu-edge-alb. Could be cert mismatch or target health. Pulling ALB logs.
Jin (infra): rolling deploy of certs finished ~10m ago? Was supposed to be staged. Checking host-level certs now.
Alex (oncall): initial customer impact: 20-30% increased error rate for requests hitting eu region, timeouts TLS handshake. No data-plane full outage.
Maria (sre): quick q: are these clients hitting `edge-proxy` or `edge-terminator`? logs: `edge-terminator` shows TLS alert 40 (handshake failure).
Tariq (net-eng): ALB target-group health shows spikes of 'unhealthy' for tg-edge-eu-01 around the same window.
Ops Runner (deploy-bot): Deploy 2026-03-15T09:12:03 by @jin -> edge-terminator/cert-rotation v2.3.4 COMPLETED
Alex (oncall): bookmarking that. If rotation correlates, consider rollback to v2.3.3 for cert bundle.
Maria (sre): collecting sample `openssl s_client -connect lb-eu-1.edge:443 -servername api.example.com` outputs. Some responses show certificate chain missing intermediate.
Tariq (net-eng): running `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:tg:eu:...` shows 27/36 targets failing healthcheck code 503/TLS. Pushing to console.
Alex (oncall): @Tariq can you shift traffic weights to eu-edge-2 (healthy) and reduce eu-edge-1 weight by 50%? That should mitigate customer impact while we debug.
Tariq (net-eng): doing weight shift now. Command: ``aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://shift-eu-weights.json`` -> applied.
SRE Bot: automated action logged: traffic weight shift executed by Tariq at 3612350200.
PagerDuty: ACK received from Alex (oncall). Auto-escalation paused.
Jin (infra): found SRV: cert bundle missing intermediate due to packaging script missing `chain.pem`. Reverting packaging to v2.3.3 and preparing hotfix.
Maria (sre): running quick healthcheck after weight shift: error rate down from 28% -> 9% over 3m. Latency stable. Good mitigation.
Alex (oncall): updating customers via status page draft: "We are seeing degraded TLS handshakes in EU region. Mitigation in progress (traffic shifted)." Will post in 10m unless resolved faster.
Tariq (net-eng): rolling back cert bundle on 12 instances of edge-terminator in eu-1: commands: ``for i in $(list); do scp cert-v2.3.3.pem $i:/etc/edge/certs && systemctl reload edge-terminator; done``. Started.
Ops Runner (deploy-bot): rollback job started by Jin -> job-id: rb-20260315-004 
Maria (sre): sanity check: curl -v https://lb-eu-1.edge/health returns 200/ok on most nodes but TLS handshake still fails on subset until reload completes.
Tariq (net-eng): after reload of first 6 hosts, ALB target health back to 84% healthy. Continuing.
Alex (oncall): important: adjust DNS TTL for the active A records to 60s so we can shift traffic faster if needed. Who can do that?
Jin (infra): I'll lower TTL for `eu.api.example.com` to 60 (route53 change applied).
SRE Bot: change noted: route53/record eu.api.example.com TTL set to 60 by Jin at 3612350605.
PagerDuty: Auto-note: incident acknowledged; no further PD escalations while under active mitigation.
Maria (sre): quick log snippet of failed handshake (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-15T09:13:21Z] peer closed during handshake, alert 40, cert chain incomplete: CN=intermediate-missing
[2026-03-15T09:13:22Z] handshake error, client_ip=10.8.4.23, latency=120ms
```
Tariq (net-eng): after full rollback and reload, ALB shows 99% healthy, TLS errors drop to baseline.
Alex (oncall): great. Post-mitigation checklist: close PD when we confirm stable for 30m, create follow-up ticket to fix packaging, add canary checks for cert chain, and add an automated smoke test in deploy pipeline.
Jin (infra): creating ticket: INFRA-4201 "cert packaging: include chain.pem in rotation" -> https://tracker.example/INFRA-4201
Maria (sre): customer impact estimate: ~1500 requests failed in 30m window, affecting ~0.8% of total daily traffic worldwide, concentrated in EU. No data loss.
SRE Bot: monitoring alert suppressed for TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE while incident active.
Alex (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. Will monitor 30m then resolve. Thanks all. :tada:
PagerDuty: Incident PD-87432 status changed to RESOLVED by Alex at 3612351600.
Ops Runner (deploy-bot): automatic post-incident checklist queued: runbook review, RCA draft starter.
Maria (sre): leaving note for RCA: investigate why packaging step skipped chain.pem on canary run and why CI did not catch it.
Tariq (net-eng): follow-on action: add ALB-level cert chain validation in healthcheck.
Alex (oncall): last update before closing: system stable, customers restored, tracking follow-ups: INFRA-4201, SRE-4302 (canary cert smoke), ENG-5500 (deployment safeguards). Closing thread in 30m if no regressions.
